caseId.description: The identifier for the case. To retrieve case IDs, use the search cases (`_find)` API. All non-ASCII characters must be URL encoded.

type.description: Filters the returned attachments by one or more attachment types, such as `comment` or `security.alert`. To filter by multiple types, repeat the parameter. Limited to 20 types.

perPage.description: The number of items to return. Limited to 100 items.

sortOrder.description: Sorts attachments by creation date: `asc` (oldest first) or `desc` (newest first).
